body:
Taken (credit to Gaudi-XIX for the report, and to aron-intframe for the reproduction and the seams this lands on) — here is a patch that fails a 200 whose reply counted no token, instead of handing its body to the agent as the answer.

## Summary

- The reply said so itself. Its `usage` member was on the wire, and every count it named was zero: nothing was generated, so whatever the body carries beside the counts — today a billing notice, tomorrow a quota page — is not the completion the agent asked for. What magpie kept of a usage was the counts alone (`cUsage.usage()` returns a value), so reported-and-zero collapsed into never-reported, and every decision that could have failed the try keyed on something else: the #733 arm on an error member, the empty-reply checks on nothing said, #2086 and #2471 on their own protocols. A well-formed `choices` body that says something walked past them all — booked `done: true`, `status: 200`, no fail, the conversation's stick dropped on the seat, turn after turn the same notice (the reporter's three attempts, three real upstream calls, byte-identical).
- The member's own saying is kept now, the way the cache counts' is (`cacheCreationReported`, ir.go): `usageReported` is wire evidence, not a counter, carried from the Chat decoder (which dropped an all-zero usage event) and the relay sniffer, through `Usage.add` and `plus`. Reported and every count zero fails the try as its words would have with their own status (errorReply's reading) — a billing notice as the 402 it owes, the seat resting as out of credit (creditRest) — at the seams where a reply can still be judged:
  - held whole (settle): the next member answers in the turn; the agent never sees the notice;
  - a translation read whole (translate's tail): the same;
  - a streamed reply, already passed (the walk's accounting): what the agent has stays as it is — a stream's text can't be taken back — but the failure is booked, the stick dropped, and the seat rested, so the session's next turn is answered elsewhere instead of the same notice again.
- The class the report asked to guard against stays exempt: a reply that never reports a usage — one that ignores `stream_options`' `include_usage` — is taken as it came, the fields said are what is read (emptyCompleted), so the rule needs no per-provider list. `TestUsageNeverReportedStaysAnAnswer` pins it, relayed and translated.
- What settle reads for the first seam is the body magpie held, and on a translation that body is magpie's own rendering — `renderUsage` embeds a usage all zero in it whatever the upstream said. The full gateway suite caught this and twenty more of the same (zenfree_v2's fakes, whose upstreams say no usage): an upstream that never reported a usage had its answer failed and held from it, the exempt class failed by the rendering's zero. Settle's read is gated on `saidUsage` now — the same wire evidence (`usageReported`) the other two seams key on, carried to the hold; `uncountedReply`'s body reading stands only beside it. Ablation on the gate turns `TestZenFreeAsOpenCode225` red again.
- A counted-nothing Chat reply whose words are innocent still fails, as #2086 counts a reply that counted nothing no reply at all; it fails as a 502 for the next member, and rests as any 502 does. Anthropic, Responses and Gemini keep their own precedents (#2086, #2471, #667); this patch is the Chat wire only. The seam the settle check lands on is the one this issue's reproduction probed (aron-intframe); the streamed half lands in the walk's accounting, as that comment anticipated.

## Verification

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| new `TestCountedNothingFailsOver` (relayed: notice as a completion; next member answers, try failed as credit) | RED before, GREEN after |
| new `TestCountedNothingTranslatedFailsOver` (translated: notice never reaches the agent) | RED before, GREEN after |
| new `TestCountedNothingStreamDropsTheStick` (streamed: first turn leaks, try failed, seat rested, next turn of the session answered by the other member) | RED before, GREEN after |
| new `TestCountedNothingTranslatedStreamDropsTheStick` | RED before, GREEN after |
| new `TestUsageNeverReportedStaysAnAnswer` (the exempt class, relayed and translated) | green before and after |
| ablation (product files back at d8b3749ef, new tests kept) | red again (all four counted-nothing tests) |
| ablation (the `saidUsage` gate out, the rest in) | red again (`TestZenFreeAsOpenCode225`, `TestZenFreeZeroCostModels`) |
| `go test -tags nogui -count=1 -timeout 25m ./internal/gateway/` | ok (585.778s, first run; a once-flaky box under three concurrent suites had failed 21 in an earlier run — see the summary's settle item for the real one among them) |
| `go test -tags nogui -race -run 'TestCountedNothing|TestUsageNeverReported|TestZenFreeAsOpenCode225|TestSniffChat'` | ok |
| `gofmt` / `go vet -tags nogui` / `go build -tags nogui ./...` | clean |
| `git apply --3way --check` at upstream tip `667317159` | applies cleanly (9 files) |

From 05b7fb9d909a1a96afdfed4352ffd8eec0bad5a2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: ggbdpq <ggbdpq@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 06:35:11 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] gateway: a 200 whose reply counted no token is not the answer
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

An upstream that answers a well-formed completion whose body is its own
billing notice — "Your subscription has expired.", its balance and its
expiry — and whose usage counts nothing had the notice delivered as the
answer: the try booked done=true, status 200, no fail, the conversation
pinned to the seat, three turns the same notice, three real upstream
calls (yetone/magpie#3967, Gaudi-XIX). What said the body wasn't the
answer was in the reply all along: it reported its usage, and every
count zero — nothing was generated, so nothing the body says was.

What was missing is the reading. A reply's usage is told by a member,
and only the counts were kept: reported-and-zero collapsed into
never-reported (cUsage.usage() returns a value), and every decision
that could have failed the try keys on something else — the #733 arm
on an error member, the empty-reply checks on nothing said, #2086 and
#2471 on their own protocols. The billing notice is well-formed and
says something, so it walked past them all.

Now the member's own saying is kept, as the cache counts' is
(cacheCreationReported): usageReported is wire evidence, not a counter
(ir.go), carried from the Chat decoder and the relay sniffer, through
Usage.add and plus. Reported and every count zero fails the try as its
words would have with their own status — a billing notice as the 402
it owes, the seat resting out of credit (errorReply's reading) —

- where the reply is held whole (settle), for the next member to
  answer in the turn, the agent never seeing it;
- where a translation read the reply whole (translate), the same;
- where a streamed reply has already passed (the walk's accounting),
  which can't be taken back: the failure is booked, the stick dropped,
  and the seat rested, so the session's next turn is answered
  elsewhere instead of the same notice again.

What settle read for the first of these is the body magpie held. On a
translation the held body is magpie's own rendering, whose usage counts
all zero whatever the upstream said — renderUsage embeds one — so the
body alone read a rendering's zero as the wire's, and an upstream that
never reported a usage (the exempt class) had its answer failed and
held from it. Settle's read is gated on saidUsage now, the sniffer's
read of the wire carried to the hold (the same usageReported the two
other seams key on); uncountedReply's body reading stands only beside
it. The full gateway suite caught this and 20 more of the same
(zenfree_v2's fakes, whose upstreams say no usage); ablation on the
gate turns TestZenFreeAsOpenCode225 red again.

A reply that never reports a usage — one that ignores stream_options'
include_usage — stays an answer, though nothing is counted of it: the
fields said are what is read (emptyCompleted), so the rule needs no
per-provider list. A counted-nothing Chat reply whose words are
innocent still fails, as #2086 counts a reply that counted nothing no
reply at all; it fails as a 502 for the next member, and rests as any
502 does.

Fixes #3967

+		emit(Event{Kind: KUsage, Usage: u})
 	}
 	return nil
 }

+package gateway
+
+import (
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/provider"
+)
+
+// A 200 whose body is an upstream billing notice and whose usage counts
+// nothing is no answer (yetone/magpie#3967): nothing was generated, so
+// the body is not the completion the agent asked for, and the try fails
+// as its words would have with their own status — a billing notice as the
+// 402 it owes — for the next member to answer. Reported and all zero is
+// what reads; a reply that never reports a usage stays an answer, as one
+// that ignores stream_options' include_usage does.
+const billingNotice = "Your subscription has expired. API key status: expired. USDT balance: 12.5 USDT."
+
+const noticeJSON = `{"id":"c1","object":"chat.completion","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"` + billingNotice + `"},"finish_reason":"stop"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":0,"completion_tokens":0,"total_tokens":0}}`
+
+const countedJSON = `{"id":"c2","object":"chat.completion","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"hello"},"finish_reason":"stop"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":12,"completion_tokens":3,"total_tokens":15}}`
+
+var noticeSSE = sse(`data: {"id":"c1","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"`+billingNotice+`"}}]}`,
+	`data: {"id":"c1","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}`,
+	`data: {"id":"c1","choices":[],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":0,"completion_tokens":0,"total_tokens":0}}`,
+	`data: [DONE]`)
+
+var countedSSE = sse(`data: {"id":"c2","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"from b"}}]}`,
+	`data: {"id":"c2","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}`,
+	`data: {"id":"c2","choices":[],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":12,"completion_tokens":3,"total_tokens":15}}`,
+	`data: [DONE]`)
+
+// The body reached the client as a completion through a relayed request,
+// where the reply comes as it came: the try fails, and the next member
+// answers in the turn.
+func TestCountedNothingFailsOver(t *testing.T) {
+	fresh(t)
+	a := &scripted{replies: []reply{{200, "", noticeJSON}}}
+	b := &scripted{replies: []reply{{200, "", countedJSON}}}
+	scriptedOn(t, "a", provider.Chat, a)
+	scriptedOn(t, "b", provider.Chat, b)
+	if err := provider.SaveGroup(provider.Group{Name: "G", Members: []string{"a/m", "b/m"}, Routing: provider.Ordered}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	s := New()
+	code, body := postAs(t, s, "", `{"model":"group/g","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}`)
+	if code != 200 || !strings.Contains(body, "hello") || strings.Contains(body, "subscription") {
+		t.Fatalf("%d %s %+v", code, body, s.trace.routes[len(s.trace.routes)-1])
+	}
+	if a.n != 1 || b.n != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("a asked %d, b asked %d", a.n, b.n)
+	}
+	r := s.trace.routes[len(s.trace.routes)-1]
+	if len(r.Tries) != 2 || r.Tries[0].Fail == "" {
+		t.Fatalf("tries: %+v", r.Tries)
+	}
+}
+
+// The same through a translation, where magpie reads the reply itself:
+// a reply that reported its usage as counting nothing is not an answer,
+// and what it said (a billing notice here) never reaches the agent.
+func TestCountedNothingTranslatedFailsOver(t *testing.T) {
+	fresh(t)
+	a := &scripted{replies: []reply{{200, "text/event-stream", noticeSSE}}}
+	b := &scripted{replies: []reply{{200, "text/event-stream", countedSSE}}}
+	scriptedOn(t, "a", provider.Chat, a)
+	scriptedOn(t, "b", provider.Chat, b)
+	if err := provider.SaveGroup(provider.Group{Name: "G", Members: []string{"a/m", "b/m"}, Routing: provider.Ordered}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	s := New()
+	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
+	s.Handler().ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/v1/messages",
+		strings.NewReader(`{"model":"group/g","max_tokens":10,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}`)))
+	code, body := rec.Code, rec.Body.String()
+	if code != 200 || !strings.Contains(body, "from b") || strings.Contains(body, "subscription") {
+		t.Fatalf("%d %s %+v", code, body, s.trace.routes[len(s.trace.routes)-1])
+	}
+	if a.n != 1 || b.n != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("a asked %d, b asked %d", a.n, b.n)
+	}
+	r := s.trace.routes[len(s.trace.routes)-1]
+	if len(r.Tries) != 2 || r.Tries[0].Fail == "" {
+		t.Fatalf("tries: %+v", r.Tries)
+	}
+}
+
+// A streamed turn cannot be taken back once its text has passed, so the
+// first turn still carries the notice; what the failure buys is the seat
+// set aside and the conversation's stick dropped, so the next turn of the
+// session is answered by another member instead of the same notice again.
+func TestCountedNothingStreamDropsTheStick(t *testing.T) {
+	fresh(t)
+	a := &scripted{replies: []reply{{200, "text/event-stream", noticeSSE}}}
+	b := &scripted{replies: []reply{{200, "text/event-stream", countedSSE}}}
+	scriptedOn(t, "a", provider.Chat, a)
+	scriptedOn(t, "b", provider.Chat, b)
+	if err := provider.SaveGroup(provider.Group{Name: "G", Members: []string{"a/m", "b/m"}, Routing: provider.Ordered}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	s := New()
+	send := func() (int, string) {
+		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
+		req := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/v1/chat/completions",
+			strings.NewReader(`{"model":"group/g","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}`))
+		req.Header.Set("x-session-id", "s1")
+		s.Handler().ServeHTTP(rec, req)
+		return rec.Code, rec.Body.String()
+	}
+	code, _ := send()
+	r := s.trace.routes[len(s.trace.routes)-1]
+	if code != 200 || len(r.Tries) != 1 || r.Tries[0].Fail == "" || r.Tries[0].Rest == nil {
+		t.Fatalf("turn1 %d fails %+v", code, r.Tries)
+	}
+	code, body := send()
+	if code != 200 || !strings.Contains(body, "from b") || strings.Contains(body, "subscription") {
+		t.Fatalf("turn2 %d %s %+v", code, body, s.trace.routes[len(s.trace.routes)-1])
+	}
+	if a.n != 1 || b.n != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("a asked %d, b asked %d across the two turns", a.n, b.n)
+	}
+}
+
+// The same streamed turn through a translation, where magpie reads the
+// events itself: the notice leaks as the first turn's text all the same,
+// and the failure is booked, the seat rested, and the stick dropped for
+// the session's next turn to be answered elsewhere.
+func TestCountedNothingTranslatedStreamDropsTheStick(t *testing.T) {
+	fresh(t)
+	a := &scripted{replies: []reply{{200, "text/event-stream", noticeSSE}}}
+	b := &scripted{replies: []reply{{200, "text/event-stream", countedSSE}}}
+	scriptedOn(t, "a", provider.Chat, a)
+	scriptedOn(t, "b", provider.Chat, b)
+	if err := provider.SaveGroup(provider.Group{Name: "G", Members: []string{"a/m", "b/m"}, Routing: provider.Ordered}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	s := New()
+	send := func() (int, string) {
+		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
+		req := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/v1/messages",
+			strings.NewReader(`{"model":"group/g","max_tokens":10,"stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}`))
+		req.Header.Set("x-session-id", "s1")
+		s.Handler().ServeHTTP(rec, req)
+		return rec.Code, rec.Body.String()
+	}
+	code, _ := send()
+	r := s.trace.routes[len(s.trace.routes)-1]
+	if code != 200 || len(r.Tries) != 1 || r.Tries[0].Fail == "" || r.Tries[0].Rest == nil {
+		t.Fatalf("turn1 %d fails %+v", code, r.Tries)
+	}
+	code, body := send()
+	if code != 200 || !strings.Contains(body, "from b") || strings.Contains(body, "subscription") {
+		t.Fatalf("turn2 %d %s %+v", code, body, s.trace.routes[len(s.trace.routes)-1])
+	}
+	if a.n != 1 || b.n != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("a asked %d, b asked %d across the two turns", a.n, b.n)
+	}
+}
+
+// The exempt class: a reply that never reports a usage — one that ignores
+// stream_options' include_usage — stays the answer it is, though nothing
+// is counted of it.
+func TestUsageNeverReportedStaysAnAnswer(t *testing.T) {
+	fresh(t)
+	a := &scripted{replies: []reply{{200, "", chatOK}}}
+	scriptedOn(t, "a", provider.Chat, a)
+	s := New()
+	if code, body := postAs(t, s, "", `{"model":"a/m","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}`); code != 200 || !strings.Contains(body, "hello") {
+		t.Fatalf("%d %s", code, body)
+	}
+	r := s.trace.routes[len(s.trace.routes)-1]
+	if len(r.Tries) != 1 || r.Tries[0].Fail != "" {
+		t.Fatalf("tries: %+v", r.Tries)
+	}
+
+	fresh(t)
+	a = &scripted{replies: []reply{{200, "text/event-stream", sse(`data: {"id":"c3","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"said anyway"}}]}`,
+		`data: {"id":"c3","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}`,
+		`data: [DONE]`)}}}
+	scriptedOn(t, "a", provider.Chat, a)
+	s = New()
+	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
+	s.Handler().ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/v1/messages",
+		strings.NewReader(`{"model":"a/m","max_tokens":10,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}`)))
+	if rec.Code != 200 || !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), "said anyway") {
+		t.Fatalf("%d %s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
+	}
+	r = s.trace.routes[len(s.trace.routes)-1]
+	if len(r.Tries) != 1 || r.Tries[0].Fail != "" {
+		t.Fatalf("tries: %+v", r.Tries)
+	}
+}

+	// its usage is all zero even for an upstream that never said one
+	saidUsage bool

 	// bytes say whether it streams after all (Write)
@@ -3052,6 +3057,18 @@ func (h *holdWriter) settle() {

+		// wire: nothing was generated, so what the body says is not the
+		// answer either (uncountedReply, #3967). The wire is what says so
+		// (saidUsage): the body here can be magpie's own rendering of a
+		// translation, which carries a usage all zero whatever the
+		// upstream said — one that never reported a usage stays an answer
+		if h.saidUsage {
+			if status, msg, ok := uncountedReply(h.held.Bytes()); ok {
+				h.failure, h.failMsg = status, msg
+				return
+			}
+		}
 	}
 	if h.alive != nil && h.alive.sent && h.status < 400 && wholeEvents(h.alive.proto, h.held.Bytes()) == nil {
 		// a 200 that is no reply of the protocol's, once the agent has a
@@ -4081,6 +4098,65 @@ func errorReply(body []byte) (status int, msg string, ok bool) {
 	return streamStatus(string(wordsOf(b))), provider.APIError(b, "the upstream reported an error"), true
 }
 
+// countedNothing is what a 200 whose reply counted no token (its usage
+// was reported, and every count zero) says of itself, in the failure the
+// hold keeps (yetone/magpie#3967): nothing was generated, so whatever the
+// body carries beside the counts — today a billing notice, tomorrow a
+// quota page — is not the answer, and the next candidate is asked, the
+// seat reading as its words do (a billing notice as out of credit).
+// A reply that names no usage at all is taken as it came: the fields said
+// are what is read, as a Responses completed naming its output and usage
+// is (emptyCompleted).
+const countedNothing = "the reply counted no tokens; what it said was not generated"
+
